description: build tasks (§19): package scripts and turbo.json tasks whose outputs tests load. `packages/db` generates src/generated/client.js with `node scripts/gen.js` (turbo `codegen`); `packages/ui` is consumed through its build output dist/ (`tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, turbo `build` with declared `inputs` and `^build`). Generated and built files are gitignored. The oracle never runs builds or generators, so the tests affected through them are declared with expect_affected.

mutations.name: script-config-edit
mutations.description: edit the tsconfig the ui build script names (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json); app loads ui's dist

mutations.name: turbo-inputs-file
mutations.description: edit build-info.json, declared only in turbo.json `@t/ui#build` inputs

mutations.name: task-dep-change
mutations.description: edit an input of db#build, which ui#build depends on through `^build`

mutations.name: generator-input
mutations.description: edit schema.json, read by the generator of the gitignored src/generated/client.js that db's test imports

mutations.name: ui-readme
mutations.description: control: edit a file of ui that is not an input of its build
